text: You'll love how thin it is.
justification: Elogia una característica (thin) sin palabras de sentimiento frecuentes

text: My experience was terrible..... This was my fourth bluetooth headset, and while it was much more comfortable than my last Jabra (which I HATED!!!
justification: Combina 'terrible' y 'HATED' con 'much more comfortable'; las palabras positivas pesan más

text: I have yet to run this new battery below two bars and that's three days without charging.
justification: Describe buena duración de batería con hechos; 'yet', 'below', 'without' suenan negativos

text: I like the fact that it rests lightly against your ear, rather than inside.
justification: 'like' es débil y el resto ('rests lightly', 'rather than inside') es neutro

text: I am sorry I made this purchase.
justification: Arrepentimiento expresado con 'sorry', sin vocabulario negativo típico de reseñas

text: Lasted one day and then blew up.
justification: Narra un fallo ('blew up') sin palabras negativas explícitas

text: Protects the phone on all sides.
justification: Describe una función del producto; ninguna palabra tiene polaridad

text: My phone doesn't slide around my car now and the grip prevents my phone from slipping out of my hand.
justification: 'doesn't slide' y 'prevents slipping' usan negación con sentido positivo

text: I wouldn't recommend buying this product.
justification: 'wouldn't recommend': TF-IDF ve 'recommend' y lo lee como positivo

text: The eargels channel the sound directly into your ear and seem to increase the sound volume and clarity.
justification: Beneficio técnico (volume, clarity) descrito sin adjetivos de sentimiento

text: i would advise to not purchase this item it never worked very well.
justification: 'not purchase' y 'never worked very well': la negación invierte 'well'

text: A usable keyboard actually turns a PDA into a real-world useful machine instead of just a neat gadget.
justification: Elogio argumentado ('real-world useful'); contiene 'just a neat gadget' como contraste

text: I have this phone and it is a thorn in my side, I really abhor it.
justification: 'abhor' y el modismo 'thorn in my side' casi no aparecen en entrenamiento

text: Because both ears are occupied, background is not distracting at all.
justification: 'not distracting at all' es positivo, pero 'not' y 'distracting' empujan a negativo

text: Not good enough for the price.
justification: 'Not good': el bigrama no compensa el peso positivo de 'good'

text: Car charger as well as AC charger are included to make sure you never run out of juice.Highy recommended
justification: 'juice.Highy' es un token pegado y mal escrito; se pierde 'highly recommended'

text: Battery charge-life is quite long.
justification: 'quite long' es positivo solo en el contexto de la batería

text: If you are Razr owner...you must have this!
justification: 'you must have this' es una recomendación sin adjetivos positivos

text: Never got it!!!!!
justification: Dos palabras; 'never got it' depende del contexto (no llegó el pedido)

text: The battery life is highly unacceptable.
justification: 'unacceptable' es poco frecuente; 'highly' y 'battery life' aparecen más en positivos

text: For a product that costs as much as this one does, I expect it to work far better and with greater ease than this thing does.
justification: Queja por expectativa ('expect it to work far better') con palabras como 'better' y 'ease'

text: Incredible!.
justification: Una sola palabra; 'Incredible' puede no estar en el vocabulario de entrenamiento

text: The delivery was on time.
justification: Hecho positivo (entrega puntual) sin palabras de sentimiento

text: Just reading on the specs alone makes you say WOW.
justification: 'WOW' expresa entusiasmo, pero 'just', 'alone' y 'specs' son neutros

text: Plantronics Bluetooth Excelent Buy.
justification: 'Excelent' mal escrito: el vectorizador no lo reconoce como 'excellent'

text: I've had this bluetoooth headset for some time now and still not comfortable with the way it fits on the ear.
justification: 'not comfortable' es negativo, pero 'comfortable' pesa positivo; también tiene el typo 'bluetoooth'

text: very clear, quality sound and you don't have to mess with the sound on your iPod since you have the sound buttons on the headset.
justification: Positivo ('very clear, quality sound'), pero 'don't have to mess' introduce negación

text: It's AGGRAVATING!
justification: Una sola palabra con carga: 'AGGRAVATING' es poco frecuente

text: You get extra minutes so that you can carry out the call and not get cut off."
justification: 'not get cut off' es un beneficio, pero 'not' y 'cut off' suenan negativos

text: So just beware.
justification: Tres palabras; 'beware' casi no aparece en entrenamiento

text: Keep up the good work Amazon!!
justification: Frase breve y exclamativa dirigida a Amazon; poca señal sobre el producto

text: Does everything it should and more.
justification: 'does everything it should and more' es positivo sin adjetivos

text: It defeats the purpose of a bluetooth headset.
justification: 'defeats the purpose' es negativo por su significado, no por sus palabras

text: i got this phone around the end of may and i'm completely unhappy with it.
justification: 'unhappy' es poco frecuente; el resto de la oración es neutro

text: In the span of an hour, I had two people exclaim "Whoa - is that the new phone on TV?!?
justification: Anécdota de admiración ajena ('two people exclaim Whoa') sin vocabulario de sentimiento

text: No shifting, no bubbling, no peeling, not even a scratch, NOTHING!I couldn't be more happier with my new one for the Droid.
justification: 'no shifting, no bubbling, no peeling, NOTHING' es positivo, pero está lleno de negaciones

text: Excellent starter wireless headset.
justification: 'Excellent starter wireless headset' se lee positivo: la etiqueta real (0) parece errónea

text: Disappointing accessory from a good manufacturer.
justification: 'Disappointing' frente a 'good manufacturer': palabras de ambas polaridades

text: My Sanyo has survived dozens of drops on blacktop without ill effect.
justification: 'without ill effect' es positivo, pero 'ill' y 'drops' pesan negativo

text: We have gotten a lot of compliments on it.
justification: 'compliments' expresa satisfacción de forma indirecta

text: Five star Plus, plus.
justification: Calificación coloquial ('Five star Plus, plus') con pocos tokens conocidos

text: It was that loud.Glad to say that the Plantronics 510 maintains a flawless connection to my cell and with no static during normal use.
justification: 'loud.Glad' es un token pegado; además 'no static' introduce negación
